title: Olivia Miles faces WNBA fine after technical foul in Lynx win over Fever
dek: Olivia Miles scored 28 points in the Minnesota Lynx's 108-100 victory over the Indiana Fever but drew her third technical foul of the season, triggering a WNBA fine. The disciplinary accumulation comes despite Miles' star performance in a Lynx win.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Miles scored 28 points in the Lynx's 108-100 victory over the Fever and faces a fine for her third technical foul of the season.
bottom_line: Miles' third technical foul in a single season signals a trend worth monitoring as the Lynx navigate playoff contention. What to watch: whether Miles draws additional technicals and whether the cumulative fines or suspension risk become a factor in late-season games.
body: Olivia Miles scored 28 points to lead the Minnesota Lynx to a 108-100 victory over the Indiana Fever, but the win came with a disciplinary cost: Miles drew her third technical foul of the season and now faces a WNBA fine, according to Sporting News.

Accumulated technical fouls trigger fines under WNBA rules; the specific amount of Miles' fine is not stated in available reports. The open questions around the incident include the exact circumstances of the technical foul in this game and the dates and contexts of Miles' prior two technical infractions.

The Lynx's victory moves them further into playoff positioning. How Miles navigates the fine system and whether a pattern of technicals affects her future availability remains unclear from current sources.
